svg.title: What a long session costs per request
svg.desc: Line chart of input cost per request over 40 requests. Without a cache, cost rises in a straight line from 17 cents to 64 cents. With a cache, the first request costs 21.5 cents, then requests cost 2 to 5 cents, except request 25, which costs 57.5 cents because the cache had expired. Totals: $16.24 without a cache, $1.58 with it, $2.12 with the one expiry.

g.text: What a long session costs per request
Input cost of each request in US dollars, over a 40-request session.
Computed, simplified: Claude Opus 5.5 API prices with the 5-minute cache ($4 input, $5 write,
$0.20 read per million tokens). 43,000 tokens at request 1, 3,000 more per request.
Output cost left out; it is the same either way.
